Motionflare turns a website into an on-brand motion graphics video.

Paste a URL. It reads the page, extracts the real logo, palette and typography, plans a shot sequence, then generates each scene as actual animation code and renders it. What comes out is kinetic typography and product motion built around your brand, not a stock clip reel with your name pasted on top.

  We rebuilt Motionflare’s entire motion engine from the ground up. Motion Engine 2.0 now powers every visual style with more than 160 motion recipes, covering typography reveals, camera moves, product UI choreography, object movement, data animation, and scene transitions. For every scene, Motionflare understands what the beat needs to communicate, selects the right motion recipe, then adapts it to the video’s style and pacing. The result is smoother, more fluid motion with far less repetition. Two videos can use the same visual style without entering, emphasizing, or transitioning in the same way.
